name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Income support scheme providing ₹6,000 per year in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 each directly into the bank accounts of landholding farmer families across India.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three direct bank transfers (₹2,000 every 4 months)
required_documents: Active Mobile Number linked to Aadhaar

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
hindi_name: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
description: The world's largest health assurance scheme providing comprehensive secondary and tertiary care hospitalization coverage to poor and vulnerable families.
benefits: Cashless health cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year in all empanelled government and private hospitals

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin
description: Flagship social welfare initiative providing financial grant assistance to rural families living in kutcha or dilapidated houses for building safe, permanent pucca homes.
benefits: Financial grant of ₹1,20,000 (plain areas) or ₹1,30,000 (hilly/difficult areas) plus ₹12,000 for toilet construction
required_documents: Land Record / Proof of plot for house

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
description: Provides deposit-free LPG connections along with a free first cylinder refill and stove to women belonging to below-poverty-line and disadvantaged rural households.
benefits: Free LPG gas connection with subsidized cylinder, free first refill, and gas stove
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of Adult Female Applicant
Ration Card / BPL Document showing family composition

name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: Government guaranteed monthly pension scheme for citizens working in the unorganized sector, ensuring dignified financial stability after retirement.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 after 60 years of age, depending on contribution
required_documents: Savings Bank Account / Post Office Account

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
hindi_name: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना
description: Part of the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) providing non-contributory monthly pensions to destitute senior citizens living below poverty line.
benefits: Monthly financial pension assistance of ₹200 to ₹500 (plus state top-up up to ₹1,000 - ₹2,500 depending on state) transferred to bank
required_documents: Age Proof (Voter ID / Birth Certificate / Medical Certificate)

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: High-interest, government-backed savings scheme launched under 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao' to build a secure financial corpus for girl child education and marriage.
benefits: Government-backed 8.2% annual compound interest, tax deduction under 80C, and completely tax-free maturity amount
required_documents: Aadhaar Card / ID Proof of Parent/Guardian

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
hindi_name: महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी योजना
description: Legal employment guarantee providing at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment in a financial year to every rural adult who volunteers for unskilled manual work.
benefits: Guaranteed 100 days wage employment per household per year at statutory state minimum wage rates with DBT payment within 15 days
required_documents: Passport Size Photos of adult family members

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
description: Provides collateral-free loans up to ₹10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises to encourage self-employment and small business growth.
benefits: Collateral-free business loans up to ₹10 Lakh in 3 categories: Shishu (up to ₹50k), Kishore (₹50k-₹5L), Tarun (₹5L-₹10L) at low interest
required_documents: Aadhaar Card / Voter ID / PAN Card

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
description: Special micro-credit facility providing affordable, collateral-free working capital loans to urban street vendors to resume and scale livelihoods.
benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan of ₹10,000 (1st tranche), ₹20,000 (2nd tranche), and ₹50,000 (3rd tranche) with 7% interest subsidy and cashback on digital transactions
required_documents: Vending Certificate / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Body (ULB) / Letter of Recommendation
